excerpt: Dalwangan Tm 1 is a registered tomato variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 1995 as NSIC 1995 Tm 07. It takes 62 to 66 days from transplanting to the first harvest, with 22.36 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about Dalwangan Tm 1 tomato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Dalwangan Tm 1 tomato takes 62 to 66 days from transplanting to the first harvest. That is 6.6 days faster than the average of the 20 tomato varieties with a day count, 70.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 22.36 t/ha beats the average of its group, 20.91. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Fusarium wilt](/diseases/fusarium-wilt), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt).

The pests and diseases that hit tomato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [late blight](/diseases/late-blight), [tomato leaf curl](/diseases/tomato-leaf-curl), [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Dalwangan Tm 1 tomato

It is recommended for the dry season. Bacterial wilt kills more lowland tomato than any other disease, so in the wet season pick a variety rated resistant to it. Choose a firm, oblong fruit if you sell to a far market, and a round, juicy one for fresh sale nearby. Heat tolerant hybrids set fruit in the hot months, when open pollinated tomatoes often drop their flowers. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 62 to 66 days from transplanting to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 22.36 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Dalwangan Tm 1?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
